academic_role_claims.schema:
CREATE TABLE academic_role_claims (
 claim_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people,
 profile_id TEXT REFERENCES person_profiles, role_phrase TEXT NOT NULL, role_level TEXT NOT NULL,
 tenure_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tenure_status IN('historical_mentioned','not_independently_verified')),
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_note TEXT NOT NULL, verification_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(verification_status='conference_bio_claim')
)

agenda_items.schema:
CREATE TABLE agenda_items (
 agenda_item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions, source_code TEXT, source_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
 title_original TEXT NOT NULL, format_original TEXT NOT NULL, date_original TEXT,
 local_date TEXT, time_original TEXT, start_time TEXT, end_time TEXT, room_original TEXT,
 source_url TEXT, evidence_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_level='planned_agenda'),
 material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_json)), UNIQUE(conference_id,source_order)
)

agenda_participants.schema:
CREATE TABLE agenda_participants (
 agenda_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agenda_items, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people, agenda_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 name_original TEXT NOT NULL, institution_original TEXT NOT NULL, profile_url TEXT,
 role_basis TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(agenda_item_id,ordinal)
)

analysis_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE analysis_versions (
 analysis_version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 analysis_kind TEXT NOT NULL, rule_label TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 is_current_snapshot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_current_snapshot IN(0,1)),
 scoring_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scoring_enabled=0),
 material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, method_note TEXT NOT NULL
)

biomarker_aliases.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_aliases (
    alias_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    biomarker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biomarkers(biomarker_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    alias_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    language TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(language IN ('zh', 'en', 'other', 'unknown')),
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('unverified', 'confirmed', 'rejected')),
    UNIQUE(biomarker_id, alias_name)
)

biomarker_analysis_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_analysis_runs (
    run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    source_manifest_or_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    analysis_window TEXT NOT NULL,
    inclusion_rules TEXT NOT NULL,
    processed_denominator INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gaps_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    generated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    statistical_metrics TEXT NOT NULL
)

biomarker_capability_matches.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_capability_matches (
    match_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biomarker_contexts(context_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    capability_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
    participating_stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    sample_or_method_fit TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('priority_evaluate', 'evidence_needed', 'exploratory', 'confirmed', 'pending_review', 'not_fit')),
    source_and_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(context_id, capability_reference, participating_stage)
)

biomarker_contexts.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_contexts (
    context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    biomarker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biomarkers(biomarker_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    domain TEXT NOT NULL,
    disease_or_complication TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_population TEXT NOT NULL,
    sample_or_fraction TEXT NOT NULL,
    clinical_use TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    time_point TEXT,
    context_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(context_status IN ('active', 'provisional', 'deprecated')),
    UNIQUE(biomarker_id, domain, disease_or_complication, target_population, sample_or_fraction, clinical_use, target_outcome)
)

biomarker_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_evidence (
    evidence_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biomarker_contexts(context_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    report_id TEXT REFERENCES reports(report_id),
    paper_id TEXT REFERENCES literature_papers(paper_id),
    study_id TEXT REFERENCES studies(study_id),
    evidence_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_role IN ('primary_finding', 'mechanistic', 'negative_or_failed', 'background_reference', 'method_comparison', 'title_mention_only')),
    reading_level TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reading_level IN ('title_only', 'abstract_only', 'full_text', 'presentation_slide')),
    method TEXT NOT NULL,
    sample_size_or_cohort TEXT,
    result_text TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
    direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(direction IN ('positive_association', 'negative_association', 'neutral_or_null', 'inconclusive', 'not_applicable')),
    validation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(validation_type IN ('discovery', 'internal_validation', 'external_validation', 'multi_center', 'meta_analysis', 'unspecified')),
    metric_value_or_interval TEXT,
    comparison_method TEXT,
    material_id TEXT REFERENCES source_materials(material_id),
    source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
    review_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('auto_extracted', 'human_reviewed', 'flagged_discrepancy', 'rejected')),
    reviewed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (report_id IS NOT NULL AND paper_id IS NULL) OR
        (report_id IS NULL AND paper_id IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

biomarker_extraction_reviews.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_extraction_reviews (
    review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('report', 'paper', 'legacy_entry')),
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome_status IN ('processed', 'positive', 'negative', 'pending', 'failed')),
    basis_detail TEXT NOT NULL,
    rule_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    batch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(run_id, source_kind, source_id)
)

biomarker_record_audits.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_record_audits (
version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES biomarker_review_versions(version_id),record_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(record_kind IN ('evidence','entity','context','match','extraction','run')),record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
original_row_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,reviewed_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(reviewed_json)),basis TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(version_id,record_kind,record_id))

biomarker_review_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_review_versions (
version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,rule_text TEXT NOT NULL,is_current INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_current IN (0,1)))

biomarker_title_reviews.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarker_title_reviews (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports, analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 review_status TEXT NOT NULL, in_denominator INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(in_denominator IN(0,1)),
 target_text TEXT, use_text TEXT, indicator_kind TEXT, basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_level TEXT NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id)
)

biomarkers.schema:
CREATE TABLE biomarkers (
    biomarker_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    standard_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    biomarker_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(biomarker_type IN ('single', 'panel', 'signature', 'family')),
    is_member_defined INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_member_defined IN (0, 1)),
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('candidate', 'reviewed', 'rejected')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes TEXT
)

conference_coverage.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_coverage (
 conference_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES conference_editions,
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 programme_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 programme_text_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_snapshot_label TEXT NOT NULL,
 original_observed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 coverage_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(coverage_json)),
 rules_path TEXT NOT NULL, rules_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 plan_path TEXT NOT NULL, plan_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 new_collection INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(new_collection=0)
)

conference_editions.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_editions (
 conference_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, series_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_series,
 year INTEGER NOT NULL, edition_label TEXT, name_original TEXT NOT NULL, organizer TEXT,
 region TEXT, country TEXT, city TEXT, format TEXT, start_date TEXT, end_date TEXT,
 local_timezone TEXT, timezone_basis TEXT, official_url TEXT, metadata_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 metadata_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 metadata_gaps TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(series_id,year)
)

conference_page_audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_page_audit (
 conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 physical_page INTEGER NOT NULL,
 parse_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 code_occurrences INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(conference_id,physical_page)
)

conference_program_occurrences.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_program_occurrences (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports,
 agenda_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES agenda_items,
 programme_pages TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(programme_pages)),
 is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_primary IN(0,1)),
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,agenda_item_id)
)

conference_report_notes.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_report_notes (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports,
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 classification_method TEXT NOT NULL,
 classification_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 cross_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(cross_tags_json)),
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id)
)

conference_series.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_series (
 series_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, abbreviation TEXT NOT NULL, name_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials
)

conference_tier_assignments.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_tier_assignments (
 conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 rule_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tier_rule_versions,
 tier_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tier_code IN('international_core','national_major','regional_key','undetermined')),
 scope_label TEXT NOT NULL,
 assessment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(assessment_status IN('user_confirmed','provisional','insufficient_evidence')),
 basis_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 basis_text TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_material_id TEXT REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT,
 evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(conference_id,rule_version_id)
)

conference_topic_scope.schema:
CREATE TABLE conference_topic_scope (
 topic_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES research_topics,
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 template_topic_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics,
 width_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(width_status IN('focused','broad')),
 boundary_text TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL
)

curated_report_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE curated_report_links (
 record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curated_research_records,
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports,
 relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(record_id,report_id)
)

curated_research_records.schema:
CREATE TABLE curated_research_records (
 record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 legacy_id TEXT NOT NULL,code_original TEXT NOT NULL,title_curated TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_level TEXT NOT NULL,reading_level TEXT NOT NULL,source_date TEXT,
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_json))
)

import_batches.schema:
CREATE TABLE import_batches (
 import_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, imported_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 imported_at TEXT NOT NULL, source_observed_on TEXT NOT NULL, source_manifest TEXT NOT NULL,
 importer_version TEXT NOT NULL, new_collection INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(new_collection=0), notes TEXT NOT NULL
)

legacy_marker_bindings.schema:
CREATE TABLE legacy_marker_bindings (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports, analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 legacy_marker_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_id_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 binding_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(binding_status='existing_title_binding_pending_review'),
 material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id,legacy_marker_id)
)

literature_author_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_author_links (
 paper_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_people,
 identity_status TEXT NOT NULL, article_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 leadership_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(leadership_status IN('paper_leadership_pending','corresponding_verified','pi_verified')),
 matching_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(paper_id,ordinal,person_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(paper_id,ordinal) REFERENCES literature_authors(paper_id,ordinal)
)

literature_authors.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_authors (
 paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_papers, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 name_original TEXT NOT NULL, affiliations_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(affiliations_json)),
 orcid TEXT, is_collective INTEGER NOT NULL, corresponding_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(paper_id,ordinal)
)

literature_classifications.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_classifications (
 paper_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES literature_papers,
 board_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics, scope_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 classification_basis TEXT NOT NULL, review_status TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_discovery_candidates.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_discovery_candidates (
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_runs, pmid TEXT NOT NULL,
 reading_status TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,pmid)
)

literature_highlights.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_highlights (
 paper_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES literature_papers,
 research_question TEXT NOT NULL, finding_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
 selection_reason TEXT NOT NULL, limits_text TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_status TEXT NOT NULL, raw_path TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_issue_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_issue_links (
 version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_issue_versions,
 issue_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_issues,
 paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_papers,
 relation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation IN('primary','background','supporting')),
 count_in_ranking INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(count_in_ranking IN(0,1)),
 basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(version_id,issue_id,paper_id),
 CHECK((relation='primary' AND count_in_ranking=1) OR (relation<>'primary' AND count_in_ranking=0))
)

literature_issue_paper_reviews.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_issue_paper_reviews (
 version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_issue_versions,
 paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_papers,
 reviewed_type TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 finding_summary TEXT NOT NULL, method_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL, result_excerpt TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_basis TEXT NOT NULL, original_board_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics,
 review_status TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_path TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(version_id,paper_id)
)

literature_issue_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_issue_versions (
 version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_on TEXT NOT NULL, input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_scope TEXT NOT NULL, input_count INTEGER NOT NULL, is_current INTEGER NOT NULL,
 evidence_path TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_issues.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_issues (
 issue_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_issue_versions,
 board_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_topics, name TEXT NOT NULL,
 boundary_text TEXT NOT NULL, progress_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
 limits_text TEXT NOT NULL, width_status TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_papers.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_papers (
 paper_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pmid TEXT UNIQUE, doi TEXT UNIQUE, pmcid TEXT,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, journal TEXT NOT NULL, journal_abbr TEXT,
 publication_date TEXT, date_precision TEXT, date_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 online_date TEXT, issue_date TEXT, window_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_tier TEXT NOT NULL, article_type TEXT NOT NULL, type_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 reading_level TEXT NOT NULL, abstract_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(abstract_json)),
 summary_curated TEXT, source_url TEXT NOT NULL, publisher_url TEXT,
 raw_path TEXT NOT NULL, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 existing_abstract_id TEXT REFERENCES related_paper_abstracts,
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_runs
)

literature_people.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_people (
 person_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, domain_scope TEXT NOT NULL,
 identity_status TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_person_roles.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_person_roles (
 person_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES literature_people,
 tier_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tier_code IN('international','national','regional','undetermined')),
 academy_kind TEXT, role_basis TEXT NOT NULL, source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
 tenure_note TEXT NOT NULL, raw_path TEXT NOT NULL, checked_on TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_runs (
 run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 collected_on TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_path TEXT NOT NULL, manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 scope_note TEXT NOT NULL
)

literature_source_checks.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_source_checks (
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_runs, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_sources,
 query_text TEXT, returned_count INTEGER, reading_status TEXT NOT NULL, gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 raw_path TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,source_id)
)

literature_sources.schema:
CREATE TABLE literature_sources (
 source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_url TEXT NOT NULL, coverage_status TEXT NOT NULL, coverage_note TEXT NOT NULL
)

maintenance_changes.schema:
CREATE TABLE maintenance_changes (
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES maintenance_runs(run_id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 entity TEXT NOT NULL,
 entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 field TEXT NOT NULL,
 before_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 after_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,ordinal)
)

maintenance_events.schema:
CREATE TABLE maintenance_events (
 event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES maintenance_runs(run_id),
 occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 event_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 detail_json TEXT NOT NULL
)

maintenance_runs.schema:
CREATE TABLE maintenance_runs (
 run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 baseline_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 diff_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 run_directory TEXT NOT NULL,
 confirmed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 confirmed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 changed_fields INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source_material_id TEXT,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('confirmed_no_change','confirmed_updated'))
)

paper_study_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE paper_study_links (
    paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES literature_papers(paper_id),
    study_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES studies(study_id),
    relation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_type IN ('confirmed_same_study', 'possible_overlap', 'shared_cohort', 'pending')),
    basis TEXT NOT NULL,
    material_id TEXT REFERENCES source_materials(material_id),
    PRIMARY KEY(paper_id, study_id, relation_type)
)

people.schema:
CREATE TABLE people (
 person_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, source_identity_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 institution_source TEXT NOT NULL, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 legacy_person_id TEXT UNIQUE, mapping_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 identity_note TEXT NOT NULL
)

person_profiles.schema:
CREATE TABLE person_profiles (
 profile_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people,
 import_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches, profile_url TEXT NOT NULL,
 read_status TEXT NOT NULL, has_substantive_bio INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_substantive_bio IN(0,1)),
 extracted_text TEXT, fetch_error TEXT, raw_material_id TEXT REFERENCES source_materials,
 evidence_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_observed_on TEXT, UNIQUE(person_id,import_id,profile_url)
)

quantity_rule_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE quantity_rule_versions (
 analysis_version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 previous_analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 reviewed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 rules_path TEXT NOT NULL,rules_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 decisions_path TEXT NOT NULL,decisions_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 review_method TEXT NOT NULL,denominator INTEGER NOT NULL,
 new_collection INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(new_collection=0),
 scoring_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scoring_enabled=0)
)

related_paper_abstracts.schema:
CREATE TABLE related_paper_abstracts (
 paper_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,pmid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,doi TEXT,title_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 journal TEXT,first_author TEXT,source_url TEXT NOT NULL,reading_level TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_json))
)

related_paper_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE related_paper_links (
 record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES curated_research_records,
 paper_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES related_paper_abstracts,
 relation_type TEXT NOT NULL,basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(record_id,paper_id)
)

report_classifications.schema:
CREATE TABLE report_classifications (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports, analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 primary_topic_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics, scope_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 eligible INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(eligible IN(0,1)), classification_basis TEXT NOT NULL,
 material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id),
 CHECK((eligible=1 AND primary_topic_id IS NOT NULL) OR (eligible=0 AND primary_topic_id IS NULL))
)

report_study_links.schema:
CREATE TABLE report_study_links (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports, study_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES studies,
 relation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(relation_type IN('confirmed_same_study','possible_overlap','shared_cohort','pending')),
 basis TEXT NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,study_id,relation_type)
)

report_tags.schema:
CREATE TABLE report_tags (
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports, analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES analysis_versions,
 tag TEXT NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 PRIMARY KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id,tag)
)

report_topic_review_notes.schema:
CREATE TABLE report_topic_review_notes (
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quantity_rule_versions,
 report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reports,
 previous_topic_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics,
 decision_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision_code IN('retain','split_assignment','reassign','excluded')),
 rationale TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_version_id,report_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(report_id,analysis_version_id) REFERENCES report_classifications(report_id,analysis_version_id)
)

reports.schema:
CREATE TABLE "reports" (
 report_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, agenda_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES agenda_items,
 conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions, source_report_code TEXT NOT NULL,
 legacy_report_id TEXT NOT NULL, legacy_evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 report_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(report_format IN('大会报告','专题报告','论文发言','海报报告','晚期突破海报')),
 evidence_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_status IN('agenda_only','abstract_results','presentation_results','paper_linked')),
 has_results INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(has_results IN(0,1)), result_text TEXT,
 independent_study_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(independent_study_status IN('not_established','pending','linked_no_independence_claim')),
 UNIQUE(conference_id,source_report_code)
)

research_topics.schema:
CREATE TABLE research_topics (
 topic_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 legacy_topic_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_topic_id TEXT REFERENCES research_topics,
 node_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(node_type IN('board','topic')), name TEXT NOT NULL,
 research_question TEXT, taxonomy_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(taxonomy_status='working_classification'),
 material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials, UNIQUE(conference_id,legacy_topic_id)
)

session_chairs.schema:
CREATE TABLE session_chairs (
 session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people, name_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 institution_original TEXT NOT NULL, profile_url TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(session_id,ordinal)
)

sessions.schema:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
 session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 source_session_id TEXT NOT NULL, title_original TEXT NOT NULL, date_original TEXT,
 local_date TEXT, room_original TEXT, material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(conference_id,source_session_id)
)

source_materials.schema:
CREATE TABLE source_materials (
 material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, import_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches,
 relative_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
 material_kind TEXT NOT NULL, source_url TEXT, reading_level TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_observed_on TEXT, original_path TEXT NOT NULL, original_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 is_derived INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(is_derived IN(0,1))
)

speaker_tier_assignments.schema:
CREATE TABLE "speaker_tier_assignments" (
 conference_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conference_editions,
 person_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES people,
 rule_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tier_rule_versions,
 tier_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tier_code IN('international','national','regional','undetermined')),
 domain_scope TEXT,
 assessment_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(assessment_status IN('provisional_existing_bio','provisional_program_role','insufficient_evidence')),
 tenure_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tenure_status IN('term_unverified','historical','honorary','chair_elect','dated_term_unverified','not_applicable')),
 rationale TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(conference_id,person_id,rule_version_id),
 CHECK((tier_code='undetermined' AND assessment_status='insufficient_evidence') OR (tier_code<>'undetermined' AND assessment_status IN('provisional_existing_bio','provisional_program_role')))
)

speaker_tier_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE speaker_tier_evidence (
 evidence_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
 conference_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 rule_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES person_profiles,
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials,
 source_locator TEXT NOT NULL,
 quote_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 context_original TEXT NOT NULL,
 char_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
 char_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
 evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(conference_id,person_id,rule_version_id) REFERENCES speaker_tier_assignments,
 CHECK(char_start>=0 AND char_end>char_start)
)

studies.schema:
CREATE TABLE studies (
 study_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, title TEXT, identity_status TEXT NOT NULL,
 doi TEXT, trial_registration TEXT, cohort_description TEXT,
 source_material_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_materials
)

tier_rule_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE tier_rule_versions (
 rule_version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
 label TEXT NOT NULL,
 assessed_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_snapshot_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 rule_path TEXT NOT NULL,
 rule_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 decisions_path TEXT NOT NULL,
 decisions_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
 assessment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
 current_snapshot INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(current_snapshot IN(0,1)),
 new_collection INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(new_collection=0)
)

topic_scope_review_targets.schema:
CREATE TABLE topic_scope_review_targets (
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 old_topic_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 new_topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_topics,
 width_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(width_status IN('broad','focused')),
 boundary_text TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_version_id,old_topic_id,new_topic_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(analysis_version_id,old_topic_id) REFERENCES topic_scope_reviews
)

topic_scope_reviews.schema:
CREATE TABLE topic_scope_reviews (
 analysis_version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quantity_rule_versions,
 old_topic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES research_topics,
 old_report_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
 action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN('split','retain_broad','retain')),
 rationale TEXT NOT NULL,evidence_gaps TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_version_id,old_topic_id)
)
